selection.name: NEON FP16 GEMV
selection.scope: One authentic decode down-projection geometry on four A76 cores: M=1,K=10240,N=2560, FP16 activation and row-major FP16 weights, FP32 accumulation/output. Report one-invocation timing and a census-weighted 42-call projection; do not measure the full linear population.

A_authenticity.evidence: OPE1 freezes decode_mlp_down_proj at M=1,K=10240,N=2560 with 42 calls/model-forward and 911148 observed invocations. FP16 activation/weight with FP32 output matches the OPE1 fp16 analytic contract and the OPE2 primitive row.
A_authenticity.limit: The deployed C02/official carriers are W8A8. CPU FP16 execution and row-major [N,K] storage are cross-ISA comparator choices, not evidence of the closed RKLLM internal dtype, layout, or placement.

B_bottleneck.evidence: OPE3 already measures the same geometry and four-A76 topology in int8; OPE2 already measures the same geometry in NPU FP16. The missing cell is a four-A76 FP16 path, which isolates the CPU dtype/ISA tax without repeating either anchor.
B_bottleneck.limit: The result cannot identify the cause of the OPE4 160.471% analytic-vs-stage gap because the W8A8 runtime is closed and no carrier proves that it dispatches FP16 down-projection to CPU.

C_capability.evidence: The measured A76 exposes fphp/asimdhp and board GCC 11.4 supports FP16 loads/conversion plus FP32 NEON FMA. K=10240 and N=2560 are divisible by the eight-half vector tile and N is divisible by four worker partitions.
C_capability.limit: The candidate uses FP16 storage converted to FP32 accumulation and does not require BF16, i8mm, SVE, SME, or FP16 FMLAL extensions.

D_deliverability.evidence: The result can add a fourth lineage-separated same-shape row beside OPE3 A76 int8, OPE2 NPU FP16, and the existing PC NF4 context row; it can also report a 42-call counterfactual projection against OPE4 TPOT.
D_deliverability.limit: No hardware win/loss, RKLLM component attribution, deployment speedup, or quality statement is deliverable.

novel_evidence_contract.new_measurement: Four-A76 FP16-storage/FP32-accumulate GEMV for the exact OPE3 down-projection geometry.
novel_evidence_contract.primary_comparison: OPE5-02 FP16 NEON versus OPE3 int8 neon_sdot on the same M/K/N, four A76 cores, and row-major [N,K] CPU layout; report latency ratio and analytic-byte ratio without treating dtype as a single isolated causal variable beyond these explicit contracts.
novel_evidence_contract.reused_anchor_no_rerun: OPE2 core0 normal-layout FP16 primitive p50=4728.208 us, 11.095011048 GB/s, correctness PASS.
novel_evidence_contract.stage_context: OPE4 C02 aggregate decode=446.1262611013072 ms/token; the 42-call CPU FP16 projection is a counterfactual isolated ratio only.
duplicate_avoidance: Do not rerun OPE2 NPU FP16 cells.
Do not rerun OPE3 int8 GEMV.
Do not add gate/up, prefill, A55, NPU, model, or full-linear-population lanes.
Do not use OPE5-03 RMSNorm timing as a GEMV baseline.

analytic_account.interpretation: The floor assumes every analytic byte is charged once per call. It is an isolated FP16 counterfactual and not an RKLLM prediction.

ope3_a76_int8.evidence_limit: Two OPE3 segments, but the frozen bus_access*64 analytic-backing gate failed and remains rejected.

ope2_npu_fp16.evidence_limit: One isolated rknn_matmul_run core0 primitive cell; not RKLLM TPOT and not a hardware ranking denominator.

decision.next_action: Freeze configs/operator/board/ope5_fp16_gemv_prereg.json and verify it before candidate implementation.
decision.no_automatic_fallback: If the preregistration is inconsistent, repair and version the conflict; do not silently select OPE5-05 or start an exploratory board run.

claim_limits: Only shape and frequency are deployment-authentic; CPU FP16 dtype/layout/execution are isolated comparator choices.
The 42-call value is a multiplication of isolated p50 unless an explicitly preregistered population sequence is measured; do not label it measured RKLLM time.
The same-shape OPE2, OPE3, OPE4, and PC rows remain lineage-separated and are not a hardware leaderboard.
No board process, candidate implementation, A55 lane, NPU rerun, RKLLM run, quality evaluation, or frozen artifact mutation occurs in this stage.
